name: v15.122.0
body:
## Breaking Changes
* Updates lookups and actions to check users’ permissions for each record they read or change. Adjusts role access for **Payment Terms Template**, **POS Invoice**, **Serial and Batch Bundle**, and **Address**, and applies the permission changes to existing sites. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59359)
* Adds viewing access to **Sales Taxes and Charges Template** for Sales Managers, Accounts Users, Stock Users, Purchase Managers and Users, and Manufacturing Managers and Users. Stock Users also gain viewing access to **Purchase Taxes and Charges Template** when tax details are fetched. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59786)

## Features
* Adds a _Designation_ column to the "Lead Details" report, showing each lead’s job title. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59746)
* Adds a _Designation_ column to the "Address and Contacts" report to display contact job titles alongside their other details. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59748)
* Adds the "Stock Ledger Entries of Cancelled Vouchers" report to find stock entries that remain active after their voucher is cancelled, with a "Cancel Stock Ledger Entries" action to cancel the affected entries and recalculate stock values. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60023)

## Bug Fixes
* Requires _Planned Qty_ to be greater than zero on each item row in a **Production Plan**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59632)
* Sets the default _Opportunity Type_ on new **Opportunity** records through the form field, so translated labels don’t block saving in another language. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59666)
* Skips pricing calculations for items in **Request for Quotation**, preventing warnings about pricing fields that aren’t available there. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59668)
* Removes extra context from the error details recorded when **Repost Item Valuation** fails. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59682)
* Checks that accounts in a **Journal Entry** belong to its _Company_ when saved, rather than waiting until submission to flag mismatches. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59688)
* Splitting a capitalized composite **Asset** updates the remaining asset’s _Purchase Amount_ to match its reduced value, and split-off assets can be submitted without another capitalization step, even after further splits. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59109)
* Allows a Repack or Manufacture **Stock Entry** to use a consumed item’s serial number for the finished item, with the item change shown in serial number traceability. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59738)
* Requires read permission for a **Work Order** before returning its details. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59689)
* Updates serial-number checks in **Stock Entry** repacking to count only numbers recorded for the matching item in the current entry. Blocks moving serial numbers to another item when either item has batches. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59741)
* Keeps cancelled **Stock Ledger Entry** records cancelled during stock valuation reposting instead of restoring them as active entries. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59770)
* Requires read access to the **Purchase Receipt** or **Purchase Invoice** used to fill in an **Asset**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59789)
* Preserves manually entered reading statuses in In Process **Quality Inspection** records linked to a **Job Card**, so rejected readings are not changed to accepted. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59810)
* Uses the selected warehouse’s company for **Stock Entry** records created from the **Item** dashboard, instead of the user’s default company. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59780)
* When _Validate Material Transfer Warehouses_ is enabled, **Stock Entry** documents created from **Material Request** transfers reject the same source and target warehouse unless their inventory dimensions differ. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59814)
* New supplier users created from a **Request for Quotation** now receive a welcome email. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59842)
* Limits editing of **Quality Action**, **Quality Feedback**, **Quality Goal**, **Quality Meeting**, **Quality Procedure**, and **Quality Review** to users with the Quality Manager role, while Desk Users retain read-only access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59858)
* Checks that each **Sales Order Item** belongs to the selected **Sales Order** before creating stock reservations. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59850)
* Adds permission checks before **Shipment** retrieves a party’s shipping address or contact details, so users need access to the related record. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59846)
* Limits sorting in the stock summary to supported stock quantity fields and ascending or descending order; other sort choices are rejected. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59852)
* Return quantity checks now calculate the stock quantity from the current item quantity and conversion factor, rather than an outdated stock quantity, so quantity changes are reflected in return limits. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59825)
* Limits sales returns from each batch to the quantity delivered, minus quantities already returned. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59818)
* Checks supplier portal users against the relevant **Supplier** record when granting access or adding users, so same-named records of other types don’t affect **Purchase Invoice** and **Supplier Quotation** actions. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59848)
* Users need permission to create **Serial and Batch Bundle** records to add new serial or batch numbers; they can still select or upload existing numbers without that permission. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59854)
* Calculates each **Material Request** transfer status independently in a **Stock Entry**, preventing one request’s status from carrying over to another. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59829)
* When a draft **Sales Invoice** is recalculated, removes a transaction-level discount if its **Pricing Rule** no longer applies, while preserving manually entered discounts and applying another valid rule when available. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59811)
* Validates **Delivery Note** returns against each item’s total delivered quantity, counting previous returns and all rows in the current return, and rejects returns for items that weren’t delivered. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59822)
* Fixes discounted **POS Invoice** status handling so partially paid invoices can be submitted and show the appropriate status. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59800)
* For Italian **Sales Invoice** payment schedules, the SWIFT/BIC code now comes from the bank linked to the selected **Bank Account**, replacing a lookup that could prevent saving. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59956)
* Makes **Sales Order** items available for invoicing again after a credit note with _Update Stock_ and _Update Billed Amount in Sales Order_ reverses their delivery and billing. Counts only return **Delivery Note** entries as returned quantities, so regular deliveries do not overwrite recorded returns. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59969)
* The **BOM** comparison tool now skips table fields it cannot match between two BOMs, avoiding errors during comparison. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59988)
* Allows users to bill the remaining amount on a **Sales Order** after its full quantity has been invoiced at a lower rate. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59976)
* Rounds _Produced Qty_ and _Process Loss Qty_ when checking completion of **Work Orders** that skip material transfer, so quantities matching _Qty To Manufacture_ are recognized as complete despite small decimal differences. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60069)
* When submitting a **Job Card**, checks the overproduction allowance only for its operation, so exceeding the allowance on one **Work Order** operation does not block job cards for other operations. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60070)
* Applies user permissions in the "Payment Terms Status for Sales Order" report, so users see payment details only for **Sales Order** records they can access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60049)
* Checks outstanding **Purchase Order** amounts against **Budget** limits in the company currency, converting foreign-currency orders before comparing them. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60108)
* For BOM-based **Stock Entry** records in Manufacture and Repack, rejects receiving more of the BOM item or its variants than the _Finished Good Quantity_ allows, preventing finished goods from being recorded without corresponding materials. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60076)
* Refreshes stock quantities in the POS item list when it reloads and ignores search results from before the reload. Item-group choices now follow the active POS session’s profile rather than an edited invoice’s profile. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60110)

## Other Changes
* The **Point of Sale** no longer refreshes item stock quantities automatically when a new order starts. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60093)

**Authors**: @rohitwaghchaure, @ervishnucs, @diptanilsaha, @mihir-kandoi, @barredterra, @Shllokkk, @Pandiyan5273
**Reviewers**: @Priyashanmugasundaram005, @rohitwaghchaure, @diptanilsaha, @khushi8112, @Sudharsanan11, @mihir-kandoi, @Shllokkk

<details>
<summary>AI content</summary>

 For these release notes, we used an LLM (OpenAI gpt-6-luna) to review and summarise the code changes, along with the associated issue and PR descriptions. It may contain typical errors and inaccuracies. You can read the prompt [here](https://github.com/barredterra/pretty_release_notes). 

Changes with the following labels were excluded:
- skip-release-notes

Changes with the following types were excluded:
- docs
 - ci
 - refactor
 - style
 - test
 - chore
 - build

</details>

body:
Link to detailed blog post: https://frappe.io/blog/product-updates/announcing-framework-erpnext-and-hrms-v1650 ## Breaking Changes * Checks user permissions for records used in accounting, stock, asset, manufacturing, and project actions, and updates role access for **Payment Terms Template**, **POS Invoice**, **Serial and Batch Bundle**, and **Address**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59360) * Allows relevant sales, purchasing, stock, and manufacturing roles to view **Sales Taxes and Charges Template**, and Stock Users to view **Purchase Taxes and Charges Template**, when loading taxes and charges. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59787) ## Features * Adds a _Designation_ column to the "Address and Contacts" report to display contact job titles alongside their other details. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59749) * Adds a _Designation_ column to the "Lead Details" report, showing each lead’s job title. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59747) * Adds “Map Raw Materials to Finished Goods” to Manufacture and Repack **Stock Entry** records, so users can link raw-material serial or batch numbers to finished goods manually or with “Auto Assign.” Updates the traceability report to include raw materials that were previously omitted. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59707) * Adds an optional group warehouse setting to **Production Plan** so raw material availability can include stock across its child warehouses, while materials are still received into the selected _For Warehouse_. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59760) * The "Stock Ledger" report now lets users select multiple _Brand_ values and shows no entries when item filters match no items. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59807) * Adds the "Stock Ledger Entries of Cancelled Vouchers" report to find stock entries that remain active after their voucher is cancelled, with a "Cancel Stock Ledger Entries" action to cancel the affected entries and recalculate stock values. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60022) * Adds the "Stock Valuation Comparison" report to compare actual stock value with expected value and create adjustment entries for valuation differences. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60059) ## Bug Fixes * Checks the combined quantity of **Material Request** rows linked to the same **Production Plan** item and rejects totals that exceed the available quantity. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59635) * Requires _Planned Qty_ to be greater than zero on each item row in a **Production Plan**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59633) * Turns off _Add Total Row_ for the seven standard trends reports on existing sites, preventing an extra total row with doubled values. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59512) * Updates **Stock Closing Entry** balances to preserve zero quantities and values recorded for batches, using parent stock entry totals only when batch details are missing. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59497) * Supplier-based item suggestions in **Material Request** now follow users’ **Item** permissions. Subcontracted **Purchase Orders** created from partially fulfilled **Material Requests** now use the remaining finished-goods quantity and its corresponding service quantity. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59634) * Sets the default _Opportunity Type_ on new **Opportunity** records through the form field, so translated labels don’t block saving in another language. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59667) * Skips pricing calculations for items in **Request for Quotation**, preventing warnings about pricing fields that aren’t available there. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59669) * Restricts the _Warehouse_ options in stock reservation to non-group warehouses belonging to the document’s company. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59653) * Accounting dimension fields in **Stock Entry**, **Asset**, and **Asset Repair** appear in the accounting dimensions section instead of the Connections tab. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59664) * Removes extra contextual details from error logs when **Repost Item Valuation** fails. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59683) * Checks that accounts in a **Journal Entry** belong to its _Company_ when saved, rather than waiting until submission to flag mismatches. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59687) * Updates party-specific item rules so restrictions account for matching rules across items, item groups, and brands. Item group rules now also apply to items in sub-groups. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59711) * The Point of Sale screen now defaults to the nearest parent **Item Group** shared by a **POS Profile**’s configured groups, instead of opening on an unpredictable group that can hide permitted items. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59722) * Adds To Pay as a valid status for **Purchase Order**, allowing submitted orders with outstanding advance payment requests to be updated. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59728) * Updates formula checks in **Financial Report Template** so valid calculations are accepted and unusable line references are rejected instead of silently producing 0.00. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59125) * Stock valuation reposting skips cancelled **Stock Ledger Entry** records, so entries cancelled during reposting do not become active again. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59769) * Updates the "Accounts Payable" report to account for payroll entries when calculating settled amounts, so settled payroll transactions are not shown as outstanding. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59793) * Updates **Payment Entry** to compare allocated and outstanding amounts at the currency’s decimal precision, so matching multi-currency allocations aren’t rejected because of tiny rounding differences. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59794) * Updates manufacturing **Stock Entry** records so operations without workstation costs are charged in proportion to the quantity completed. Costs recorded in earlier entries are deducted to prevent charging the same operation cost again. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59806) * Preserves manually entered reading statuses in In Process **Quality Inspection** records linked to a **Job Card**, so rejected readings are not changed to accepted. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59809) * Sets the _Company_ on **Stock Entry** records created from the **Item** dashboard to match the selected warehouse instead of the user’s default company. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59779) * Checks linked rows in a **Stock Entry** against their **Material Request**, even when earlier rows are unlinked, and blocks saving when the items don’t match. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59701) * Requires read permission for a **Work Order** before returning its details. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59690) * Recalculates _Total Working Hours_ in **Timesheet** when a time log row is added or duplicated. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59750) * New supplier users created from a **Request for Quotation** now receive a welcome email. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59841) * Limits editing of **Quality Action**, **Quality Feedback**, **Quality Goal**, **Quality Meeting**, **Quality Procedure**, and **Quality Review** to users with the Quality Manager role, while Desk Users retain read-only access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59857) * Checks that each **Sales Order Item** belongs to the selected **Sales Order** before creating stock reservations. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59849) * Displays the "Profit and Loss Statement" chart as bars instead of a line. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59831) * Limits sorting in the stock summary to supported stock quantity fields and ascending or descending order; other sort choices are rejected. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59851) * Requires create access to **Serial and Batch Bundle** when adding new serial or batch numbers; users can still use existing numbers without that access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59853) * Return quantity checks now calculate the stock quantity from the current item quantity and conversion factor, rather than an outdated stock quantity, so quantity changes are reflected in return limits. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59824) * When a draft **Sales Invoice** is recalculated, removes a transaction-level discount if its **Pricing Rule** no longer applies, while preserving manually entered discounts and applying another valid rule when available. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59812) * Limits sales returns from each batch to the quantity delivered, minus quantities already returned. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59817) * Calculates each **Material Request** transfer status independently in a **Stock Entry**, preventing one request’s status from carrying over to another. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59830) * Fixes discounted **POS Invoice** status handling so partially paid invoices can be submitted and show the appropriate status. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59801) * Checks supplier portal users against the relevant **Supplier** record when granting access or adding users, so same-named records of other types don’t affect **Purchase Invoice** and **Supplier Quotation** actions. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59847) * Adds permission checks before **Shipment** retrieves a party’s shipping address or contact details, so users need access to the related record. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59845) * Validates **Delivery Note** returns against each item’s total delivered quantity, counting previous returns and all rows in the current return, and rejects returns for items that weren’t delivered. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59821) * Finds existing Italian e-invoice XML attachments on **Sales Invoice** records during regeneration, so replacing an invoice replaces the old file instead of adding a second one. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59946) * Applies user permissions to the "Payment Ledger" report, filtering results by the companies and customers or suppliers each user can access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59954) * The **BOM** comparison tool now skips table fields it cannot match between two BOMs, avoiding errors during comparison. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59833) * Scales raw material quantities in **Stock Entry** records created from partially completed **Job Card**s to match the completed quantity, leaving materials for pending work in WIP. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59945) * Makes **Sales Order** items available for invoicing again after a credit note with _Update Stock_ and _Update Billed Amount in Sales Order_ reverses their delivery and billing. Counts only return **Delivery Note** entries as returned quantities, so regular deliveries do not overwrite recorded returns. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59968) * Applies user permissions in the "Payment Terms Status for Sales Order" report, so users see payment details only for **Sales Order** records they can access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60048) * Allows users to bill the remaining amount on a **Sales Order** after its full quantity has been invoiced at a lower rate. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59975) * For Italian **Sales Invoice** payment schedules, the SWIFT/BIC code now comes from the bank linked to the selected **Bank Account**, replacing a lookup that could prevent saving. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59955) * When warehouse transfer validation is enabled, **Stock Entry** transfers created from **Material Requests** reject the same source and target warehouse, including transfers with matching inventory dimensions. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59878) * For **Sales Order** rows with _Ensure Delivery Based on Produced Serial No_, _Reserve Stock_ is cleared and hidden so existing stock is not reserved for items whose serial numbers are reserved during manufacturing. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59828) * When submitting a **Job Card**, checks the overproduction allowance only for its operation, so exceeding the allowance on one **Work Order** operation does not block job cards for other operations. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60066) * Rounds manufactured and process-loss quantities when checking **Work Order** completion for orders that skip material transfer, so orders that meet _Qty To Manufacture_ are marked Completed instead of left In Process. name: v16.37.0
body:
## Features
* Other apps can now add their own voucher types to the **Bank Reconciliation Tool**, with options shown only for transactions they apply to. Users can create these vouchers in the dialog or open them for full-page editing. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59313)

## Bug Fixes
* Adjusts the _Must Be Whole Number_ check to account for small rounding differences in unit conversions, so quantities that round to a whole number aren’t rejected as fractional. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59364)
* The “UAE VAT 201” report now shows sales VAT in the company’s currency for foreign-currency invoices, matching the currency used for sales amounts. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59366)
* Blocks submission of a **Delivery Note** or a **Sales Invoice** with _Update Stock_ when a **Sales Order** item marked _Ensure Delivery Based on Produced Serial No_ has no reserved serial numbers or uses a serial number that is not reserved for it. New **Work Orders** for these items reserve stock by default; the setting is hidden and cleared on the **Sales Order** when stock reservation is disabled in **Stock Settings**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59381)
* Skips loading open activities for unsaved **Lead**, **Opportunity**, and **Prospect** records, preventing a not-found error when opening their forms. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59389)
* Sets the correct _Transaction Type_ for each item when evaluating **Pricing Rule** settings, so item-specific rules are checked against the right transaction type. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59409)
* Updates the "Stock Ledger" and "Accounting Ledger" previews so transfer and manufacture entries for **Work Order** records with reserved stock temporarily release the reservation, avoiding insufficient-stock errors during preview. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59428)
* Updates batch- and serial-based reservations on **Work Order** to count only matching stock that is transferred or consumed, including material consumption, and recalculates reserved quantities after stock movements. The **Work Order** continues to show reserved stock and offer "Unreserve" while stock remains, even after completion; the dialog lists only reservations and quantities that still hold stock. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59427)
* When creating a **Stock Entry** from a **Job Card**, the secondary-item quantity calculation uses entries from that Job Card only, so entries from other Job Cards in the same work order don’t reduce its quantity. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59435)
* The "Purchase Register" now filters by _Supplier Group_ from the **Supplier** record, so older invoices without a saved group value can still appear in filtered results. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59439)
* Updates **Production Plan** raw-material reservations to account for linked **Work Orders** that use a different warehouse, reducing duplicate reserved demand in stock totals. Refreshes affected plan warehouses’ stock totals when a work order changes. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59440)
* Corrects component quantities in **Stock Entry** documents created from a **Work Order** when a phantom BOM row uses a different unit of measure than the item’s stock unit. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59446)
* Limits the _Bank Account_ options in **Bank Statement Import** to company bank accounts for the selected company. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59452)
* Automatic production updates no longer reopen a closed **Production Plan**; it stays closed until explicitly reopened. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59455)
* Updates stock reservations for a **Production Plan** when Work Order activity moves it into or out of Completed, so raw material and sub-assembly reservations reflect the plan’s status. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59450)
* In **POS Closing Entry**, defaults _Closing Amount_ to _Expected Amount_ for payment methods missing from the **POS Opening Entry**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59460)
* Removes the stray `{}` from the message shown when a backdated stock transaction requires authorization, so users see clear instructions to contact the listed users. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59538)
* Allows **Repost Item Valuation** to cancel and recreate stock ledger entries for **Stock Reconciliation** records, which could previously cause the recreation to fail. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59532)
* Updates account filters in **Invoice Discounting** to use the current _Company_, so the available accounts reflect the company selected on the form. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59551)
* Converts service costs copied from foreign-currency purchase orders into company currency in **Subcontracting Orders**, so finished goods include the converted cost in their valuation. Updates existing orders and draft **Subcontracting Receipts** with the converted costs. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59368)
* Updates **Sales Invoice** and **Purchase Invoice** menus to show document-creation options only when users can create the related documents; certain **Purchase Invoice** actions also require edit access. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59375)
* Recalculates finished goods’ _Planned Qty_ after a manufacturing **Stock Entry** updates a **Work Order**, so process loss is no longer counted as planned stock after completion and the planned quantity is restored if the entry is cancelled. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59423)
* Applies **Stock Reconciliation** entries that set an item's quantity to zero when calculating **Stock Closing Entry** balances, so subsequent stock movements are counted from zero. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59490)
* Uses only completed **Stock Closing Entry** records as opening balances for later periods, skipping entries that are failed, queued, or still in progress. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59495)
* Prevents stock vouchers from being saved when a **Serial and Batch Bundle** belongs to a different company, including bundles for rejected items. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59521)
* Shows invoice amounts and totals in the associated account’s currency for invoices with a negative outstanding balance in the bank reconciliation payment window. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59542)
* Matching vouchers now appear the first time you open the "Actions" dialog in the Bank Reconciliation Tool, instead of requiring you to reopen it. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59543)
* Checks that users have permission to select the specified **Company** before returning an item's valuation rate. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59562)
* Blocks the **Work Order** manufacture dialog when _Qty for Manufacture_ is not greater than pending process loss, because no finished goods would be produced. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59569)
* Copies comments from a **Lead** to an **Opportunity** even when the current user lacks permission to create them. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59571)
* Makes _From Date_ optional in the "Stock and Account Value Comparison" report and limits "Repost GL Entries" to Accounts Managers, with checks for vouchers in closed periods. **Stock Closing Entry** now sets _From Date_ based on the previous closing and requires closings to follow in date order; carried-forward batch balances are no longer double-counted, and existing chained entries may need regeneration using "Regenerate Stock Closing Entry". (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59566)
* Comments, communications, tasks, and events are copied or linked to related records only when you have permission to view the source record. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59575)
* Updates item stock quantities in the Point of Sale selector when a new order starts, so recent sales appear without requiring a page refresh. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59578)
* Updates stock handling so backdated transactions submitted concurrently include earlier-posted entries saved later and create a **Repost Item Valuation** when later entries need recalculation. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59371)
* **Stock Settings** hides _Auto create Serial and Batch Bundle for outward_, _Do not update Serial / Batch on creation of auto bundle_, and _Set Serial and Batch Bundle Naming Based on Naming Series_ when _Activate Serial / Batch No for Item_ is off, and reloads after that setting changes. It prevents turning the setting off while an **Item** uses serial or batch tracking and blocks enabling _Has Serial No_ or _Has Batch No_ while the setting is off; existing tracked items can still be saved. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59574)
* Values incoming stock in **Stock Entry** material transfers using the value removed from the source warehouse plus additional costs, including for serial- and batch-tracked items, so rounding differences between the transfer’s two sides are not posted to the Stock Adjustment account. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59594)
* **Purchase Invoice** now rejects duplicate items when _Update Stock_ is off, unless _Allow Item to be Added Multiple Times in a Transaction_ is enabled in **Buying Settings**; the same item remains allowed on separate rows when linked to different purchase receipts or orders. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59609)
* When stock reservations are enabled, "Get Items" on manufacturing **Stock Entries** limits transferred batch quantities to the amount not reserved by other vouchers when it can cover the row; otherwise, it leaves the picks unchanged and submission reports the reservation conflict. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59603)
* Uses the original receipt rate to value batch and serial returns from a **Subcontracting Receipt**, including returns involving rejected-material warehouses. Existing returns need reposting to update their stock values. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59608)
* Checks serial and batch reservations for **Work Order** and **Subcontracting Order** rows against reservations across all warehouses, including stock moved to work in progress or sent to suppliers. When adding a partial reservation, it records the row’s full required quantity so subsequent reservations are checked against the correct total. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59611)
* Returned components in **Work Order** transactions now reduce the work-in-progress balance, so later returns show only the remaining quantity and manufacturing entries don’t count returned stock as transferred material. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59618)
* Blocks component returns in **Stock Entry** until the linked **Work Order** is Completed or Closed. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59619)
* The "Item-wise Sales Register" now displays results when an invoice has no matching **Customer** record, using the customer name and group recorded on the invoice. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59627)
* Displays the server’s error message when a statement download fails in **Process Statement Of Accounts**, and skips `"General Ledger"` statements for customers with no transactions in the selected period. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59631)
* Checks party-specific item restrictions when saving a transaction, so changing the customer or supplier after adding items does not bypass those rules. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59637)
* Requires read access to a **Material Request** and allows **Work Order** creation only for submitted Manufacture requests that are not stopped. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59592)
* Keeps allocation rows selectable in the unreconcile dialog while their fields remain read-only. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59644)

## Performance Improvements
* Speeds up searches for **Item** records in link fields by using a text index to narrow down matches. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59350)
* Caches access checks for source documents that provide locked item prices, avoiding repeated checks for each item row and reducing delays with large documents. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59606)

**Authors**: @Sudharsanan11, @mihir-kandoi, @Pandiyan5273, @deepeshgarg007, @Shllokkk, @ervishnucs, @kaulith, @Afsalsyed, @rohitwaghchaure, @diptanilsaha

## Bug Fixes

* Blocks submission of a **Delivery Note** or a **Sales Invoice** with _Update Stock_ when a **Sales Order** item marked _Ensure Delivery Based on Produced Serial No_ has no reserved serial numbers or uses a serial number that is not reserved for it. New **Work Orders** for these items reserve stock by default; the setting is hidden and cleared on the **Sales Order** when stock reservation is disabled in **Stock Settings**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59384)
* Skips loading open activities for unsaved **Lead**, **Opportunity**, and **Prospect** records, preventing a not-found error when opening their forms. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59388)
* Sets the correct _Transaction Type_ for each item when evaluating **Pricing Rule** settings, so item-specific rules are checked against the right transaction type. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59408)
* The "Purchase Register" now filters by _Supplier Group_ from the **Supplier** record, so older invoices without a saved group value can still appear in filtered results. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59438)
* Updates **Production Plan** raw-material reservations to account for linked **Work Orders** that use a different warehouse, reducing duplicate reserved demand in stock totals. Refreshes affected plan warehouses’ stock totals when a work order changes. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59441)
* Limits the _Bank Account_ options in **Bank Statement Import** to company bank accounts for the selected company. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59451)
* Automatic production updates no longer reopen a closed **Production Plan**; it stays closed until explicitly reopened. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59456)
* Updates stock reservations for a **Production Plan** when Work Order activity moves it into or out of Completed, so raw material and sub-assembly reservations reflect the plan’s status. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59453)
* In **POS Closing Entry**, defaults _Closing Amount_ to _Expected Amount_ for payment methods missing from the **POS Opening Entry**. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59459)

* Recalculates finished goods’ _Planned Qty_ after a manufacturing **Stock Entry** updates a **Work Order**, so process loss is no longer counted as planned stock after completion and the planned quantity is restored if the entry is cancelled. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59422)
* Turns off _Add Total Row_ for the seven standard trends reports on existing sites, preventing an extra total row with doubled values. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59511)
* Prevents stock vouchers from being saved when a **Serial and Batch Bundle** belongs to a different company, including bundles for rejected items. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59520)
* Checks that users have permission to select the specified **Company** before returning an item's valuation rate. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59561)
* Copies comments from a **Lead** to an **Opportunity** even when the current user lacks permission to create them. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59570)
* Updates item stock quantities in the Point of Sale selector when a new order starts, so recent sales appear without requiring a page refresh. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59577)
* Updates material transfer valuation so the receiving warehouse uses the value removed from the source, plus additional costs, reducing rounding differences posted to the Stock Adjustment account. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59595)

(https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59610)
* Uses the original receipt rate to value batch and serial returns from a **Subcontracting Receipt**, including returns involving rejected-material warehouses. Existing returns need reposting to update their stock values. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59607)
* The "Item-wise Sales Register" now displays results when an invoice has no matching **Customer** record, using the customer name and group recorded on the invoice. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59626)
* Displays the server’s error message when a statement download fails in **Process Statement Of Accounts**, and skips `"General Ledger"` statements for customers with no transactions in the selected period. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59630)
* Checks party-specific item restrictions when saving a transaction, so changing the customer or supplier after adding items does not bypass those rules. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59638)
* Requires read access to a **Material Request** and allows **Work Order** creation only for submitted Manufacture requests that are not stopped. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59591)

## Performance Improvements
* Caches access checks for source documents that provide locked item prices, avoiding repeated checks for each item row and reducing delays with large documents. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/59605)
